name: Airborne Surveillance Radar
_note: Airborne variant of the long-range rotating ARSR, mounted on a MOVING ownship platform (platform='ownship' -> loadRunFile routes via addOwnshipFromDef). HasINS=true so detections report in Scenario (world) frame despite platform motion. Narrow 1.5deg azimuth beam (sparse false alarms, unlike airborne_IRST's 360deg FOV bug). az/el/RANGE measurement -> fully observable, standard CV/IMM tracking (no MSC-RPEKF needed). Reference: MathWorks 'Multiplatform Radar Detection Generation' (airborne rotating fusionRadarSensor with HasINS).
